description: This file defines the 'Token' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, located in the 'Aws\Token' namespace. It implements token management functionality, including storing and retrieving AWS security tokens with expiration handling, serialization, and deserialization.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A basic implementation of the AWS Token interface that manages AWS security tokens, including expiration logic and serialization functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Token object with a security token string and optional expiration timestamp.

methods.name: __set_state
methods.description: Recreates a Token object from an array of state values.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the stored AWS security token.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp of the token.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired based on current time and the expiration timestamp.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the token object into an associative array containing token and expiration data.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the token object into a JSON string.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Restores the object state from a serialized JSON string.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Converts the object into an array suitable for serialization.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Restores object properties from an array of data.
